item.title: SAP EWM Interview Questions and Answers for 2026
item.description: The SAP EWM questions interviewers ask most, from warehouse structure and process types to warehouse order creation, POSC and LOSC, availability groups, RF and embedded EWM, with answers checked against SAP's training material.

item.title: The Universal Journal (ACDOCA) in SAP S/4HANA Explained
item.description: ACDOCA is the single line-item table for finance and controlling in S/4HANA. Here is what it replaced, what changed for cost elements, currencies and reporting, and what it means for your conversion and custom code.

item.title: What Is SAP Joule? Capabilities, Requirements and Practical Use Cases
item.description: Joule is SAP's AI copilot, embedded across SAP's cloud applications. This guide explains what it does, how agents and Joule Studio fit in, what you need to switch it on and how SAP handles your data.

item.title: SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition vs Private Edition: How to Choose
item.description: Public Edition is standard SaaS with half-yearly upgrades; Private Edition is S/4HANA in SAP's private cloud with room to convert and customise. Here is how they really differ and how to decide.

item.title: SAP PI/PO End of Maintenance: What 2027 and 2030 Mean and How to Move to SAP Integration Suite
item.description: Mainstream maintenance for SAP Process Orchestration 7.5 ends in 2027. Here is what that means, what SAP's assessment and migration tools can and cannot do, and how to plan the move.

item.title: SAP EWM vs WM: Key Differences and How to Plan the Move in S/4HANA
item.description: LE-WM is no longer the target for warehouse management in S/4HANA. This guide compares WM, Stock Room Management and basic and advanced EWM, and shows how to decide where your warehouses should go.

item.title: SAP MM Interview Questions and Answers, Including What Changed in S/4HANA
item.description: The SAP MM questions that come up again and again in interviews, with concise answers, plus the S/4HANA changes such as MATDOC, Business Partner and MRP Live that separate strong candidates.

item.title: SAP S/4HANA Migration Checklist: From Assessment to Go-Live, Step by Step
item.description: A phase-by-phase checklist for moving from SAP ECC to S/4HANA, built on SAP's own conversion guide, with the tools, reports and SAP Notes you need at each step.

item.title: SAP ECC End of Maintenance in 2027: What It Means and What to Do Next
item.description: Mainstream maintenance for SAP ECC ends on 31 December 2027. Here is what changes, what your options are and how to plan a move that does not rush your business.

item.title: SAP Clean Core Explained: What It Means and Why It Matters
item.description: Clean core is the principle behind upgrade-friendly SAP systems. Here's what it means in practice and how to move towards it, step by step.

item.title: RISE with SAP Explained: What's Included and What to Ask Before You Sign
item.description: A plain-English guide to the RISE with SAP subscription, what it covers, what it doesn't, and the questions that protect you in negotiation.

item.title: Brownfield vs Greenfield vs Selective Data Transition: Choosing Your S/4HANA Approach
item.description: The three ways to get to S/4HANA compared side by side, with the questions that decide which one is right for you.
